csv_project_name: New Mexico State Fair Grounds Master Plan
csv_agency: State of New Mexico Purchasing Div/GSD
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of the Request for Proposal (RFP) is to solicit sealed proposals to establish a contract through competitive negotiations for the procurement of Professional Services based on the master planning scope of work described below. All potential offerors are to read, understand and accept the requirements of this Request for Proposals (RFP). Potential offerors must be a firm who can go beyond conceptual visioning and into implementable land use plans, building and infrastructure design and phasing, entitlement strategy, DDA/PPP structuring, and development packaging. The firm would need to provide Urban Planning + Civil Engineering, Infrastructure + horizontal design, vertical design and implementation and Development advisory and implementation. Detailed Master planning activities may include the following: Refine the agreed upon Preferred Pathway A Phase I Early Win Improvements developed by Stantec. The scope of work includes new development and land preparation, pedestrian improvements at Central and San Pedro Avenues, internal roadways and utility infrastructure, a public park with public realm improvements and a sports stadium. The awarded firm will also work with all stakeholders to solicit and compile qualified anchor developers for the development and funding of affordable housing, retail/mixed use space and possible hotel. Development advisory, policy and implementation will be needed for the stadium including a DDA/PPP solution.
